seen.cipher: Numeric cipher, in-line numbers separated by points (e.g. 33.3.25.51.80.50.57.3 under 'Jacobi', 13.14 under 'Angliae, Belgii'). Letters are written over the groups, red glosses over code numbers ('Turcam', 'Gallum', 'rex Prussiae', 'Regem Galliae'). Every cipher run on scans 181-182 carries a gloss, including those in the margin, so Kalliope's 'an einigen Stellen dekodiert' understates it. Checked run by run by eye; the glosses were not re-derived against a rebuilt table
